 package redactheaders
 
+import "strings"
+
+var sensitiveHeaders = map[string]bool{
+	"authorization":       true,
+	"proxy-authorization": true,
+	"cookie":              true,
+	"set-cookie":          true,
+	"x-api-key":           true,
+}
+
+// Redact returns a deep copy of headers with sensitive header values replaced
+// by []string{"[REDACTED]"}. Header name matching is case-insensitive; the
+// original key spelling is preserved. Returns nil if headers is nil.
 func Redact(headers map[string][]string) map[string][]string {
-	return headers
+	if headers == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	out := make(map[string][]string, len(headers))
+	for key, values := range headers {
+		if sensitiveHeaders[strings.ToLower(key)] {
+			out[key] = []string{"[REDACTED]"}
+			continue
+		}
+		copied := make([]string, len(values))
+		copy(copied, values)
+		out[key] = copied
+	}
+	return out
 }
